name: Dhampir
heading: Dhampir Base Traits and Traditional Dhampir Traits
settingLanguages: Language assignments use Etharis regional names and core standard language choices where relevant. Etharis has no universal Common language.
rulesCompatibility: The revised 2025 book credits SRD 5.2.1 and the examples use 2024 core classes.
sourceDistinctions: The example takes all eight traditional traits. Natural Attack and the first-tier Draining Attack provide fangs and temporary HP. Charm Person and Friends both use the Warlock list.

name: Downcast

settingLanguages: Language assignments use Etharis regional names and core standard language choices where relevant. Etharis has no universal Common language.
rulesCompatibility: The revised 2025 book credits SRD 5.2.1 and the examples use 2024 core classes.
sourceDistinctions: Touch of Life grants resistance. Divine Sangromancy provides the extra healing. The example takes Thaumaturgy and Sanctuary from the Cleric list.
